description: This file contains implementation of SHA-256 hash functions, including initialization, update, transformation, and finalization routines, for cryptographic hashing.

methods.name: blk_SHA256_Init
methods.description: Initializes SHA-256 context with starting values and zero offsets.

methods.name: blk_SHA256_Update
methods.description: Processes input data in chunks, updating the SHA-256 context.

methods.name: blk_SHA256_Final
methods.description: Finalizes the hash computation, applies padding, and outputs the digest.
